response.analysis_summary: The singleton implementation and its code presence, factory creation paths and initializer data, CREATE2 nonce and its callback-derived salt, callback, masterCopy selector branch, predicted-address query inputs, fallback calldata, call value, caller, empty-initializer skip branch, code-inspection queries, and gas budget are externally controlled. The proxy address and delegated storage effects are dependent outcomes.

candidates.name: singleton implementation address
valid_perturbations: replace the implementation with another deployed compatible contract
candidates.affected_operation: proxy deployment and delegated fallback execution
candidates.affected_state: singleton storage slot and all delegated behavior

candidates.name: initializer payload
valid_perturbations: change encoded setup values while preserving a valid selector
invalid_perturbations: ABI value that cannot be encoded as bytes

candidates.name: CREATE2 salt nonce
valid_perturbations: replace nonce while holding singleton and initializer constant
candidates.affected_state: deployed proxy address and deployment existence

candidates.name: callback address
valid_perturbations: replace one callback implementation with another
candidates.affected_state: proxy address derivation and callback-side state

candidates.name: proxy fallback calldata
candidates.source: fallback copies msg.data and delegatecalls singleton
valid_perturbations: change function selector or encoded arguments to another valid call
invalid_perturbations: calldata inconsistent with the selected ABI
candidates.affected_state: proxy storage modified by delegated code

candidates.name: transaction gas budget
valid_perturbations: vary gas limit above the successful threshold
boundary_perturbations: one execution step below the threshold
invalid_perturbations: gas limit rejected by the client or below intrinsic transaction cost
candidates.affected_operation: initializer call, delegatecall, callback, or CREATE2 sequence

candidates.name: factory createProxy singleton argument
valid_perturbations: replace the implementation with another deployed compatible contract
candidates.affected_state: proxy singleton slot and delegated behavior

candidates.name: factory createProxy initializer data
valid_perturbations: change encoded setup values while preserving a valid selector
boundary_perturbations: payload that makes the proxy revert
invalid_perturbations: ABI value that cannot be encoded as bytes
candidates.affected_operation: post-deployment call into the new proxy

candidates.name: callback-derived salt folding
candidates.parameter_type: callback address folded into the CREATE2 salt
valid_perturbations: change the callback and observe a different derived address
candidates.affected_operation: CREATE2 address derivation and post-creation callback

candidates.name: masterCopy selector match
candidates.parameter_type: first calldata word compared to the masterCopy selector
valid_perturbations: query masterCopy with and without trailing bytes
invalid_perturbations: calldata inconsistent with the selected ABI

candidates.name: predicted-address query inputs
feasible_values: valid singleton and initializer and nonce
valid_perturbations: query address predictions for different deployment tuples

candidates.name: factory initializer call value
candidates.parameter_type: value forwarded on the post-deployment call
valid_perturbations: attempt to forward value on the initializer call
candidates.affected_operation: post-deployment call into the new proxy

candidates.name: singleton code presence at deployment
valid_perturbations: deploy a proxy backed by an address without code

candidates.name: runtime and creation code inspection
feasible_values: code compared against a deployed proxy
valid_perturbations: compare queried code with the deployed proxy's code
invalid_perturbations: call on a client without code introspection
observable_outcomes: bytecode equality with the deployed proxy

candidates.name: creation-data singleton encoding
candidates.parameter_type: singleton address encoding in creation data
valid_perturbations: use a singleton whose address has leading zero bytes

candidates.name: empty-initializer skip branch
valid_perturbations: deploy with and without an initializer call
invalid_perturbations: ABI value that cannot be encoded as bytes
